○ trial-9tp · Apply the approved release 2 credit agreement   [P2 · OPEN]
Owner: csells · Type: task
Created: 2026-09-08 · Updated: 2026-09-08

DESCRIPTION

  Meridian Credits quotes loyalty credits for a subscription reseller. The    
  local Python CLI accepts one JSON object on stdin and emits exactly one JSON
  object on stdout; run python3 main.py. Preserve {"command":"ping"} ->       
  {"status":"ok","product":"Meridian Credits"} and the existing unknown-      
  command response. No network, clock, locale or third-party package is       
  needed. Malformed input is outside these issues.                            
                                                                              
  A charge line has exactly line_id, account_id, subscription_id, service_on, 
  and charge_cents. The three IDs are nonempty strings; line_id is unique     
  within a request. A subscription is identified by the pair (account_id,     
  subscription_id); the same subscription_id can occur under different        
  accounts, and a subscription can have several charge lines. service_on is a 
  valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31.         
  charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. No line is excluded by   
  its service date. Each request is the complete charge set of one            
  independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line    
  collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order means Unicode code-point   
  order. JSON object key order is immaterial; do not add response keys beyond 
  those specified.                                                            
                                                                              
  Release "1.0" is the initial agreement. An omitted release selects the      
  current agreement; an explicit supported release selects that version.      
  Versions introduced in an issue remain supported afterward. Public suites   
  name a specific release and send explicit release values, so their          
  expectations remain applicable when the current agreement changes. Run a    
  supplied suite with python3 test_public.py --cases PATH.                    
                                                                              
  Finance has permanently adopted release 2.0 as the current agreement: Each  
  line's uncapped credit is 15% of charge_cents, rounded down separately to   
  integer cents. The 3000-cent credit cap is shared by all lines with the same
  account_id, across its subscriptions. Distinct groups have independent caps.
  Within each cap group, credit is assigned to lines in this priority: largest
  charge_cents first; equal charges use increasing line_id. Each line receives
  its uncapped credit up to the group's remaining cap; later lines receive    
  only the remaining credit, or zero. The total credit is the sum of assigned 
  line credits. A line's amount due is its charge minus its assigned credit;  
  the total due is total charges minus total credit.                          
                                                                              
  Requests to quote and total with omitted release now use release "2.0".     
  Support explicit release "2.0" with the same behavior. Explicit release     
  "1.0" quote and total requests continue to use the original approved        
  agreement. Request/response shapes are unchanged; the response release      
  identifies the agreement actually used. This replaces the current agreement 
  for every supplied charge set, regardless of service dates.                 
                                                                              
  Example current quote request: {"command": "quote", "line": {"line_id": "L- 
  1", "account_id": "A", "subscription_id": "S", "service_on": "2026-04-15",  
  "charge_cents": 19999}}                                                     
  Response: {"release": "2.0", "credit_cents": 2999, "amount_due_cents":      
  17000, "line_id": "L-1"}

Meridian Credits release "1.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, established in trial-hdk, consumed by trial-etu total): Each charge lines uncapped credit is 10% of charge_cents, floored to an integer cent, computed per line. A shared 2400-cent credit cap applies per (account_id, subscription_id) group -- not per line and not per statement. Distinct groups (different account_id or different subscription_id) get independent 2400-cent caps. Within a cap group, lines are ordered by service_on ascending, ties broken by line_id ascending (Unicode code-point order); each line in that order receives its uncapped credit up to the groups remaining cap, so later lines may receive a reduced amount or zero once the cap is exhausted. A line credit never depends on lines outside its (account_id, subscription_id) group. For "quote" (single line), the line is its own one-line group, so credit_cents = min(charge_cents*10//100, 2400). For "total" (a full statement of lines), do NOT sum independent per-line quotes -- group all supplied lines by (account_id, subscription_id), apply the ordered cap-sharing assignment above within each group, then credit_cents = sum of assigned line credits and amount_due_cents = sum(charge_cents) - credit_cents. This 10%-rate/2400-cap/group-by-subscription-with-priority-order rule is the release 1.0 agreement and remains the current agreement unless a later release supersedes it; future releases should preserve 1.0 behavior for requests that name release "1.0" explicitly.

operation_argv: Meridian Credits release "2.0" credit agreement (Finance-approved, established and made current in trial-9tp, superseding release "1.0" as the current agreement): Each charge lines uncapped credit is 15% of charge_cents, floored (rounded down) separately to an integer cent, computed per line -- not per statement. A shared 3000-cent credit cap applies per account_id alone, across ALL of that accounts subscriptions (unlike release 1.0, which capped per (account_id, subscription_id) pair). Distinct account_id values get independent 3000-cent caps. Within a cap group (all lines sharing an account_id), lines are ordered by charge_cents descending (largest charge first), ties broken by line_id ascending (Unicode code-point order); each line in that order receives its uncapped credit up to the groups remaining cap, so later lines in priority order may receive a reduced amount or zero once the cap is exhausted. Total credit for a statement = sum of assigned line credits; a lines amount_due_cents = its charge_cents minus its assigned credit; a statements total amount_due_cents = total charge_cents minus total credit_cents. This replaces the current agreement for every supplied charge set regardless of service_on dates -- there is no grandfathering by date. Requests to quote/total that omit "release" now use "2.0". Requests that explicitly send release "2.0" get the same behavior. Requests that explicitly send release "1.0" continue to use the original release 1.0 agreement (see meridian-credits/release-1.0-credit-cap-agreement) -- release 1.0 was NOT altered by this change, only superseded as the default/current release. Response shape is unchanged from 1.0 (quote: release, line_id, credit_cents, amount_due_cents; total: release, credit_cents, amount_due_cents); the "release" field in the response reports whichever release was actually used to compute the result. This 15%-rate/3000-cap/group-by-account-only-with-charge-descending-priority rule is the release 2.0 agreement and is the current agreement unless a later release supersedes it.
